# gringo.bingo

An English-Spanish bilingual immigration terminology reference.

## Purpose

This project provides authoritative bilingual terminology, definitions, legal references, immigration forms, adjournment codes, and case law references used in United States immigration practice.

## Audience

- immigration attorneys
- accredited representatives
- interpreters
- translators
- asylum officers
- immigration judges
- journalists
- students
- migrants

## Preferred citation

Immigration Glossary - Glosario de lo migratorio
https://gringo.bingo
